description: ICS techniques used by IOControl, ATT&CK software S9046 (v1.0)
name: IOControl (S9046)

techniques.comment: IOCONTROL has executed arbitrary commands using system calls as well as scripts with the UNIX Shell.(Citation: Claroty-IOCONTROL)
IOCONTROL has conducted port scans on a network.(Citation: Claroty-IOCONTROL)
IOCONTROL has used DNS over HTTPS (DoH) via CloudFlare’s API to translate hostnames to IP addresses.(Citation: Claroty-IOCONTROL)(Citation: Dragos 2025 Year in Review)(Citation: Armis-IOCONTROL)

IOCONTROL connects to C2 servers using the MQTT protocol over port 1883 and 8883 (encrypted via SSL/TLS). The command-and-control servers are resolved using DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH).(Citation: Claroty-IOCONTROL)(Citation: Dragos 2025 Year in Review)(Citation: Armis-IOCONTROL)
